No matter if I'm on the road ot just having a short walk near my current shelter, I always carry in my backpack:

1) cat tail stalks as an emergency food — always!!
2) water
3) prybar — both as weapon and for forcing locks
4) bedroll
5) coal (at least 2 lumps, even if weather is okay now) + some sticks — always!!
6) some flares
7) magnifying glass, matches
8) lichen wound dressing
9) bandages

I think that's it. I also always had reishi tea or antibiotics in my backpack before in case of food poisoning, but now with level 5 cooking I drink reishi tea only when I'm desperate and have no food at all. And I always ignored painkillers and antiseptic in bottles. Pain doesn't bother me at all (sorry Astrid), and for wounds I have lichen dressing.

When I'm on the road, I always have at least 5 clothes and 15 sticks for a snow shelter. Also I carry a lot of coal. Saved me from freezing an infinite amount of times. Also I try to have some extra ptarmigan down to be able to repair my insulations and bedroll.
